text:
Priya: Heads up — ZenWell flagged an overcharge. They downgraded from Dedicated-XL to Dedicated-L on 2025-11-15 but invoices show Dedicated-XL billed through 2025-12-14. Invoice INV-2025-11-3421 charged $18,200. Customer asking for a retroactive pro-rated credit of $6,130. Can finance approve?

Ethan: I pulled the billing run — provisioning lag caused the plan switch to not take in our metering. Stripe webhook has plan_change at 2025-11-15 02:03 UTC but allocation change recorded on 2025-12-01. Reconciliation attached in support thread.

Carlos: Per deal-desk rules, credits > $5k need a sign-off. This is $6,130 so we need Deal Desk + Finance lead. What's the churn risk if we don't credit?

Priya: Support ticket ZW-8392 — customer upset, PS says churn risk = high without credit. They switched because cost/perf mismatch. SQL I ran:
```
SELECT date, plan, charged_amount
FROM billing_events
WHERE customer_id = 'zenwell'
ORDER BY date;
```
Result snippet:
2025-11-01, Dedicated-XL, 18200
2025-12-01, Dedicated-L, 12070
Difference (pro-rated adjustment requested): 18200 - 12070 = 6130

Lena: OK — provisional approval from Finance for $6,130 as a one-off credit memo. Need Deal Desk to record approval and Legal to confirm no contract exception required. Priya, open a Deal Desk ticket with the attached support thread and include proposed credit memo ID.

Priya: Created Deal Desk request DD-2025-447 with justification and PS note. Tagging @Carlos for final sign-off.

Carlos: Reviewed DD-2025-447 — approve. Please include a short customer-facing note that this is a provisioning timing issue, not a pricing change.

Priya: Ack. Draft note: "We issued a one-time retroactive credit for the overcharged month due to a provisioning timing mismatch. This does not change your future plan pricing." Want me to send? :email:

Lena: Send it. Also: Billing automation — BillingBot, can you queue credit memo CM-2025-11-78 for INV-2025-11-3421 amount=6130 reason='downgrade provisioning lag'?

BillingBot: queued credit memo CM-2025-11-78 (amount: $6,130) for invoice INV-2025-11-3421. ETA: 24h to appear on customer account and next statement. Reference: #CM-2025-11-78.

Ethan: Noted. I'll mark the invoice as adjusted in our AR sheet and notify PS to close the support ticket after customer confirmation. :thumbsup:

Priya: Thanks everyone — closing this thread once BillingBot confirms the credit posted.

BillingBot: CM-2025-11-78 posted to customer account at 2025-12-02T14:20:07Z.

Priya: Confirmed — customer notified and PS got acceptance. Marked as one-off adjustment, no contract amendment. Closing. :white_check_mark:
